subject: general
question: The 'National Mission on High Yielding Seeds' aims to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**increase production of high-quality seeds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Mission on High Yielding Seeds** aims to boost agricultural productivity by enhancing the availability of **high-quality seeds** to farmers.
 
• The initiative focuses on ensuring that seeds with better yield potential and disease resistance are accessible to farmers, supporting their efforts toward sustainable farming practices.
 
• The mission addresses the issue of **low productivity** in Indian agriculture by promoting the use of seeds that are scientifically developed for higher efficiency and adaptability to various climatic conditions.
 
• It is part of India's larger strategy to achieve **self-reliance in agriculture** by improving crop yields and reducing dependency on imported seeds.
 
• By increasing the production of quality seeds, the mission contributes to enhancing food security and supporting the livelihood of farmers. *Hence, the correct answer is increase production of high-quality seeds.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cold Storage Infrastructure:**

 
 
• Cold storage facilities are essential for preserving perishable agricultural produce like fruits, vegetables, and dairy products.
 
• However, the **National Mission on High Yielding Seeds** does not aim to develop cold storage infrastructure; this is addressed under other agricultural schemes.
 
 
 
• **Irrigation Facilities:**
 
 
• Effective irrigation is critical for improving agricultural productivity, particularly in regions with erratic rainfall.
 
• While irrigation is vital, the **National Mission on High Yielding Seeds** does not directly address irrigation facilities; this falls under programs like the **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY).**
 
 
 
• **Organic Farming Practices:**
 
 
• Organic farming focuses on using natural inputs and avoiding synthetic chemicals to enhance soil health and produce healthier crops.
 
• Promoting organic farming practices is not the focus of the **National Mission on High Yielding Seeds**; this is covered under initiatives like the **Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY).**
 
 
 
• **Importance of High-Quality Seeds:**
 
 
• High-quality seeds are scientifically developed to increase yield, improve resistance to diseases, and adapt to diverse climatic conditions.
 
• They play a crucial role in achieving the goals of the **National Mission on High Yielding Seeds**, ensuring food security and agricultural sustainability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of Seeds in Agriculture:**

 
 
• Seeds are the foundation of agriculture; their quality directly impacts crop yield, food security, and farmer income.
 
• India has been focusing on improving the production of high-yield seeds to ensure the country’s agricultural sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Government Schemes Supporting Agriculture:**
 
 
• Other schemes like **PMKSY** for irrigation and **PKVY** for organic farming complement the efforts of the **National Mission on High Yielding Seeds.**
 
• Together, these initiatives contribute to the overall development of the agricultural sector in India.
